purpose: let the chart reach the current bar WITHOUT recomputing any sealed historical artifact
sealed_artifacts_touched: NONE — the episode tables and pt{N}_signals parquets are read for their boundary only, never rewritten

base_match.method: each family's own build_episodes (the priority-resolved t_sig SQL), imported rather than reimplemented, run against the current 1D store

h1_match.why: the frozen 1H membership caches cover only episodes whose 10-day path is AVAILABLE, so a post-boundary episode has no 1H evaluation. Reporting False would claim 'looked and found nothing' when nothing has been looked at.
h1_match.to_enable: materialise the 1H microstructure for these episodes from the current 1H store — which is itself under a qualification HOLD

no_backfill: a mark produced during FORWARD_SOURCE_HOLD does NOT become evidence if the source later qualifies; this file is a view, not an accrual ledger
outcome_exposure: NOT_EXPOSED — no outcome value is read

evidentiary_status.statement: NON-EVIDENTIARY. Every row in this file was produced while the 1H source was on qualification HOLD.
evidentiary_status.not_forward_evidence: a FORWARD_SOURCE_HOLD mark is not weak forward evidence — it is not forward evidence at all
evidentiary_status.no_promotion: these rows can never be promoted or backfilled into the canonical forward record when the source later qualifies; the HOLD interval stays permanently outside it
evidentiary_status.why: source qualification must be satisfied BEFORE signal and X are constructed. Allowing retroactive promotion would make the gate optional in practice, which is the same as having no gate.

amended_by: additive evidentiary-status clarification; no row or computed value changed
